mapper.sql: SELECT al.member_id, CAST(SUM(CAST(h.quantity AS SIGNED)) AS SIGNED) AS holding_quantity, CAST(SUM( (CAST(s.current_price AS SIGNED) - CAST(h.avg_price AS SIGNED)) * CAST(h.quantity AS SIGNED) ) AS SIGNED) AS profit_amount, SUM(CAST(h.avg_price AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) * h.quantity) AS purchase_amount FROM account_link al JOIN holding h ON h.account_id = al.account_id AND h.quantity > 0 JOIN stock s ON s.stock_code = h.stock_code GROUP BY al.member_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY
COALESCE(p.profit_amount, 0) DESC,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.purchase_amount, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE p.profit_amount * 100.0 / p.purchase_amount END DESC,
m.member_id ASC ) AS rankPosition,
m.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, m.profile AS profile,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.is_stock_public, FALSE) = TRUE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS tradeHistoryPublicYn,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.purchase_amount, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE p.profit_amount * 100.0 / p.purchase_amount END AS returnRate, COALESCE(p.holding_quantity, 0) AS holdingQuantity, COALESCE(p.profit_amount, 0) AS profit
FROM member m
LEFT JOIN settings s ON s.member_id = m.member_id
LEFT JOIN (
) p ON p.member_id = m.member_id
WHERE m.member_role = 'USER'
AND COALESCE(s.is_stock_public, FALSE) = TRUE
ORDER BY rankPosition ASC

SELECT ranked.rank_position FROM ( SELECT m.member_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.purchase_amount, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE p.profit_amount * 100.0 / p.purchase_amount END DESC, m.member_id ASC ) AS rank_position FROM member m LEFT JOIN settings s ON s.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN (
) p ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE m.member_role = 'USER' AND COALESCE(s.is_stock_public, FALSE) = TRUE ) ranked WHERE ranked.member_id = #{memberId} AND ranked.rank_position <= 3

CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.purchase_amount, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE p.profit_amount * 100.0 / p.purchase_amount END DESC,
m.member_id ASC ) AS rank_position FROM member m LEFT JOIN settings s ON s.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN (
) p ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE m.member_role = 'USER' AND COALESCE(s.is_stock_public, FALSE) = TRUE ) ranked WHERE ranked.member_id = #{memberId} AND ranked.rank_position <= 3

SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.purchase_amount, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE p.profit_amount * 100.0 / p.purchase_amount END AS returnRate, COALESCE(p.profit_amount, 0) AS profit FROM member m JOIN settings s ON s.member_id = m.member_id AND COALESCE(s.is_stock_public, FALSE) = TRUE LEFT JOIN (
) p ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId}
